environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the Go binary on port 8080, fronted by an internal ALB with no WAF. The ALB target group routes /dashboard and /health directly. The service is accessible from the corporate VPN (10.0.0.0/8 CIDR). Kafka topic 'user-events' accepts messages from any authenticated producer in the MSK cluster. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured on the ALB or application.

config.kafka: Amazon MSK, SASL/SCRAM auth, any authenticated producer can write to user-events topic
